summary: Comprehensive testing of Lead Intake & Notification System for Breamway Auto Transport CRM. All 18 backend tests passed. Frontend tests verified notification bell, panel, real-time toast popup with View Lead/Start Quote/Dismiss buttons, and navigation to quote detail.

backend: POST /api/leads/incoming with valid API key creates lead (quote with status 'lead')
POST /api/leads/incoming with invalid API key returns 401
POST /api/leads/incoming with nested vehicle object {year, make, model} parsed correctly
POST /api/leads/incoming with flat vehicle fields parsed correctly
POST /api/leads/incoming with location strings 'City, ST' parsed into city/state
GET /api/leads/specs returns complete vendor posting specifications with API key
GET /api/leads/api-key returns vendor API key (superadmin only)
GET /api/notifications returns notification list with unread_count
GET /api/notifications/stream (SSE) connects with valid JWT token
frontend: Clicking bell opens notification panel with list
Panel shows 'Mark all read' button when unread notifications exist
Each notification has View and Quote action buttons
New lead via API triggers real-time toast popup
Toast popup shows View Lead / Start Quote / Dismiss buttons
Clicking View button navigates to quote detail page
Dashboard shows new lead in Recent Quotes after vendor lead posted
Leads count updates on dashboard after new lead

test_credentials.vendor_api_key: Dynamic - use GET /api/leads/api-key to retrieve current key

seed_data_creation: Created test leads during testing, cleaned up via TestCleanup class
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lead intake and notification system fully tested and working. Vendor API key is stored in MongoDB settings collection. SSE endpoint requires JWT token as query param. Real-time notifications work via SSE broadcast. Toast popup appears with View Lead/Start Quote/Dismiss buttons. Notification panel shows unread items with blue left border.

vendor_lead_intake.creates_notification: Yes, broadcasts to all SSE clients
vendor_lead_intake.vehicle_parsing: Supports nested object or flat fields

frontend_notifications.bell_icon: Visible in header with unread badge
frontend_notifications.panel: Opens on click, shows notifications with View/Quote buttons
frontend_notifications.toast_popup: Real-time popup with View Lead/Start Quote/Dismiss
frontend_notifications.navigation: View button navigates to quote detail
